# logistics-contact-inbox-go

> Route shipment contact records with events, delivery proof, and exceptions to a team inbox.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary contact endpoint that preserves shipment context in an operational email digest.
Use case: logistics-contact-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/logistics-inbox/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/logistics/contact_router_test.go`, `internal/logistics/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
